provenance.arm_B_gets_no_report_frame: row['own'] is None on every arm B row: a generative model has no self-report distinct from its output, and populating it would turn classify()'s entailed branch into an amnesty for invention

single_process_measurement_reason: arm B was produced by 3 sequential chunk invocations plus a merge, each under the 600 s command cap, communicating through experiments\MP-E8\results\armB_state/model_d*.pt. Recording false here is the point: a wall-clock claim that pretends one process did the whole run is the kind of cost number H4 cannot be compared on.
